name: PrepaidTopUpPromotionManager
tagline: Plan, approve, launch and track prepaid recharge promotions – with overlap checks, budget burn, uptake pacing and an eligibility checker.
description: A complete trade-marketing app for prepaid mobile operators in one Power Apps code component. Recharge bundles and offers move from draft through review and approval (segregation of duties, discount limit) to launch; a calendar flags overlapping offers for the same segment and channel; dashboards show redemptions, spend, budget burn, uptake and ROI; and care or retail staff can check whether a subscriber qualifies. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen and connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL or the Power Pages Web API without JSON.
features: Approval workflow with segregation of duties and a discount limit
Overlap detection for segment + channel + dates; launch blocking
Budget burn, forecast overspend and pacing chart
Uptake funnel and ROI by promotion and type
Eligibility checker: segment, channel, minimum top-up, tenure, limit per subscriber, budget
Record uptake with over-budget confirmation and undo
Bulk submit, pause and owner assignment; CSV export; clone
Phone layout with bottom navigation; keyboard and ARIA support
